subject: Billing lane & PO field alignment for Clearsky engagement
messages:
From: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@clearsky.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>; procurement@clearsky.com
Date: 2027-04-16T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Billing / PO fields question for onboarding

Hi Ava (and procurement team),

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — Clearsky is excited to move forward. Before we finalize SOW signatures, our AP team has a couple of hard requirements we need aligned so we can raise POs on our side:  

- PO must include a 10-digit PO ID and be referenced on the invoice line-level (not just header).
- Invoice remit address must be the Redwood US LLC address (we can share exact remit later).
- We run weekly statement reconciliations and prefer consolidated weekly invoices rather than monthly ones. Can Redwood support a weekly invoice cadence?
- Standard payment window is net60 for Clearsky. Is there flexibility to net45 or net30 if we provide a PO commitment for the quarter?

I attached our PO export sample (PO_template.xml) — can you confirm Redwood can consume this without manual edits, or tell us what the minimal fields are so our ERP can map them automatically?

Appreciate a note on the above so we can scope procurement lead times.

Best,
Ethan
Ethan Miller
Director, Procurement
Clearsky Health
[Attachment: PO_template.xml (application/xml)]

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@clearsky.com>
Cc: procurement@clearsky.com
Date: 2027-04-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing / PO fields question for onboarding

Hi Ethan — thanks for the clear list. Looping in our billing and contracts owners but wanted to confirm the high-level answers so procurement can plan: 

- PO ID on line-level: Required. Our invoice pipeline validates PO ID at the line item and header; if the PO ID is present only on header we can still process but it triggers manual matching for some ERPs. Ideally include the PO ID on the invoice line as in your sample.
- Remit address: Yes — we can set Redwood US LLC as the remit. Please share the exact text your AP needs (company name, address, tax id).
- Weekly consolidated invoices: Supported. We offer a weekly consolidated invoice lane; it will group charges by invoice week and include line-level PO mapping. Note that weekly cadence may affect how prepay/commit discounts are applied (we calculate slab attainment on invoice cycles).
- Net terms: Our standard public offer is net45 for enterprise deals with a PO commitment; net30 is eligible for an early-pay discount. Net60 is acceptable but it impacts discount eligibility (longer float reduces discount options).

Attached is our PO field spec (Redwood_PO_Spec.pdf) — the ERP mapping table is on page 2. Quick callout of the minimal required fields we need: PO ID, account legal name, BU code, line quantity, line unit price, tax flag, and remit reference. If you can ensure those in the PO export then automated matching should be clean.

I'll bring Vanessa from Sales and Priya from Finance into the thread for the commercial and discount details.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Enterprise Onboarding
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_PO_Spec.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@clearsky.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-17T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing / PO fields question for onboarding

Hi Ethan — Vanessa here from Sales. Great to see procurement moving quickly. A few points on commercial flexibility and packaging: 

- If Clearsky commits to a quarterly minimum (we can define in the SOW), we can offer a 2.0% volume discount applied at invoice-cycle reconciliation. That discount requires PO coverage for the quarter and reconciles at the end of each invoice period.
- If Clearsky prefers faster payment (net30), we can offer a 1.5% early-pay discount that applies per invoice if paid within 30 days. This is additive to the volume-discount reconciliation model but subject to a max cap described in the SOW.
- Weekly invoices: We can enable the weekly billing lane. Note operationally that weekly lanes are processed on Mondays; any adjustments after the weekly close will be applied to the next week's invoice.
- On the PO file: Ava's team raised minimal fields — if your ERP can export a simple CSV with those mappings we can ingest directly. We can also accept the PO_template.xml but will need the mapping script run once by our onboarding team (typically a 1–2 day setup).

I'm attaching our proposed discount schedule showing how slab thresholds and early-pay interact. If you'd like, I can draft a short amendment (DocuSign) to add net45 and the weekly-lane commitment to the master SOW so procurement has something to route.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: discount_schedule.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Ethan Miller <ethan.miller@clearsky.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>; Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearsky.com
Date: 2027-04-20T16:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing / PO fields question for onboarding

Vanessa / Ava — thanks, this is helpful. Procurement confirms they can add the PO ID to the line-level export and switch our weekly statement to a consolidated weekly invoice. Two quick asks before I route to our legal/AP queue: 

1) Can you prepare a short amendment (DocuSign) that:  
   - Notes weekly consolidated invoicing lane,
   - Pins net45 as the agreed payment terms for the first two quarters (with optional review), and
   - Includes the 2.0% quarterly-volume discount reconciliation mechanics.

2) We'll share a sample mapped export from our ERP (clearsky_sample_po.json) so you can validate the ingest. If onboarding confirms mapping no manual work will be required on our side.

If you can have the amendment and a one-line summary by EOD Thursday we can get POs out the following week.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Regards,
Ethan Miller
Director, Procurement
Clearsky Health
